description: Defines options structures for various normalization modules in the torch::nn namespace, including LayerNorm, LocalResponseNorm, CrossMapLRN2d, Normalize, and GroupNorm, along with their functional counterparts.

classes.name: LayerNormOptions
classes.description: Options for the LayerNorm module, including normalized shape, epsilon, and elementwise affine flag.

classes.name: LayerNormFuncOptions
classes.description: Functional options for layer normalization, including normalized shape, weight, bias, and epsilon.

classes.name: LocalResponseNormOptions
classes.description: Options for LocalResponseNorm module, including size, alpha, beta, and k.

classes.name: CrossMapLRN2dOptions
classes.description: Options for CrossMapLRN2d module, including size, alpha, beta, and k.

classes.name: GroupNormOptions
classes.description: Options for GroupNorm module, including number of groups, channels, epsilon, and affine flag.

classes.name: GroupNormFuncOptions
classes.description: Functional options for group normalization, including number of groups, weight, bias, and epsilon.
